description: quartermaster: a SessionEnd tally of this session's friction (streamed locally, no LLM, no network), a SessionStart line that keeps the reuse-first capability charter in front of Claude (check project code, native platform features, the standard library, and installed dependencies, plugins, and skills before proposing another capability; improve a misfiring skill instead of adding one; stay silent when nothing was missing), and Stop hooks that block once per overdue session so Claude offers a focused optimization round at a real pause while refreshing marketplace freshness and reporting available Loadout updates or needed plugin reloads. The resupply Stop hook stays silent on stop_hook_active re-entry, after its offer cooldown, and after decline-resupply resets the evidence window. No Stop hook analyzes content; the update check only changes the local freshness cache. Current or explicit standing user permission authorizes the round, and each recommendation is separately approved unless the same standing permission covers that class of change. It also reports local Loadout freshness health and warns when this session loaded older plugin code.
